subject: MedFast renewal: private stack extension & staging plan
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@medfast.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: ops@medfast-ops.com
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MedFast renewal: private stack extension & staging plan

Hi Jonas,

We're at renewal and want to expand our Private footprint for analytics and compliance workloads. Current ask: provision two additional isolated clusters (analytics and reporting), separate KV caches for PHI-bound traffic, and a controlled cutover window so our SOC team can validate isolation.

High-level constraints:
- Need environment parity between our staging and Prod in US-West region.
- Prefer 18-month term for cost predictability.
- Procurement wants a single amendment that captures term + cluster additions.

I've attached our internal intent doc (medfast-renewal-intent-2026.pdf) and a sketch of isolation requirements. Can you outline lead times, cost delta, and any changes to support SLAs?

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Director of Cloud Ops
MedFast Health

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com

Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MedFast renewal: private stack extension & staging plan

Elena,

Thanks — got the intent doc and the sketch. High level response before we pull in procurement:

- Lead time: provisioning 2 additional isolated clusters (prod+staging parity) is ~6-8 weeks from signed amendment for US-West, depending on capacity reservations.
- Capacity: to meet your analytics latency targets we'll recommend 2 x p4d-equivalent nodes per cluster with a dedicated KV cache shard.
- Term: 18-month term is doable — will need to route through sales discounts and dedicated capacity pricing.
- SLAs: adding isolated clusters will not change base SLA but we can offer a regional failover add-on for the analytics cluster as an optional line item.

Next steps for us: Neha will produce a delta pricing amendment and a provisioning checklist; Monica will coordinate the rollout timeline with engineering.

Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Team,

Drafting the amendment and a provisioning playbook now. Key items I'm putting into the SOW and checklist:

1) Scope changes
- Add two isolated clusters: analytics-cluster (prod) + analytics-staging.
- Dedicated KV shard per cluster for PHI-bound traffic; prefix-level routing enforced via policy.

2) Capacity and HW profile
- Recommend 2 x A100 nodes per cluster (or equivalent committed vGPU), autoscale policy capped for burst.

3) Term & commercial
- 18-month term; propose 10% volume discount on the added cluster capacity if signed by Oct 15.
- Billing: monthly amortized over term with a one-time provisioning fee.

4) Cutover & validation
- Staged cutover: staging provision -> verification window (48h) -> prod provisioning -> blue/green switch (2h scheduled window).

5) Compliance evidence
- We'll provide audit logs, network topology exports, and a SOC-2 evidence bundle for the isolated stacks.

I've attached the provisional SOW and the provisioning checklist (rdw-ds-proposal-5461.docx and redwood-provisioning-checklist.xlsx). Monica: can you confirm engineering ETA for the validation window (I put 6-8 weeks)? Karthik: loop in infra for prefix routing and KV shard allocation.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
